summary: `add` in src/add.js subtracted its arguments (a - b), so add(2, 3) gave -1. I changed the operator to a + b; the lib tests went from 0 to 1 passing. I ask orus to open a change pull request with that fix.

actions.title: Fix add to sum its arguments instead of subtracting them
actions.body:
Fixes #1.

`add` in `src/add.js` computed `a - b`, so `add(2, 3)` returned `-1` instead of `5`.

Change: `exports.add = (a, b) => a + b;`

Before: `npm test` (lib) fails on `adds two numbers` with `-1 !== 5`.
After: the lib test passes (1/1).
